title: Six weeks of the token, candle by candle
description: body = open to close · wick = the day's full reach · ink = closed down · hollow = closed up

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered day labels and open, close, low and high prices. A complete quote requires finite nonnegative prices with low at or below open/close and high at or above them. Missing or invalid quotes remain unavailable; zero and unchanged prices are measured.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
